name: plastic-legacy-theme
description: Built-in color theme (bundled - hadialqattan.plastic-legacy, MIT, see LICENSE.txt), extracted from the app's own default palette, with the upstream theme's syntax-highlighting (tokenColors) rules and its editor colors (gutter, diff, peek, find, selection, widgets, minimap) included. Workbench-only colors stay out, along with editorWarning.foreground, which would recolor the app's own warnings.
